manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Stack the three bowls on the table.

Task description: The objects are the three light-green bowls in the scene. Gather them and stack them vertically into one nested pile.

Success criteria: Pick up and stack the bowls so all three are nested vertically, with the upper bowl base inside the lower bowl opening and supported by it.

## Execution tips

- For a bowl near the white box, approach a rim section away from the box edge and pen, on the side facing open table space. Leave room for the outer finger to reduce scraping or shifting.
- Consider gripping the bowl wall below the rim with one finger inside and one outside, ensuring full pad contact on both surfaces. Match the opening to wall thickness and approach clearance without spanning the entire outer diameter.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are inside and outside the same wall section, rather than interpreting image overlap as a secure grasp. After grasping, lift slightly off the support and check for sliding or tilting.
- During transport, keep the bowl base above other bowl rims. Make any needed pose adjustments where there is clearance, reducing contact with neighboring bowls during lateral movement.
- Align the held bowl's bottom inside the receiving bowl's opening and lower gently, watching clearance between the outer finger and lower rim. If the finger contacts first, lift slightly and adjust rather than forcing it down and causing jamming or tipping.
- Before releasing or regrasping, support the bowl securely on the lower bowl or table. Open only enough to clear the wall and withdraw through available space to reduce lifting or toppling the stacked bowls.

After the grippers opened, both bowls returned upright; the image shows them nested and stable. Next I will withdraw the fingers and move to the third bowl on the white box.
I withdrew from the two-bowl stack, which remains stable in the image. I am approaching the white box area and will grasp the third bowl from the side away from the box edge and pen.

The third bowl's wall is between the fingers. It is near the edge of the box, so I will close and make a small test lift first, confirm the grasp and clearance from the box, then transport it sideways.
The third bowl is rising with the gripper, and the grasp point remains visible. I will continue checking stability in small steps; the two-bowl stack has not changed.
The third bowl has been lifted off the white box, and one small pose adjustment is complete. Next I will move it above the two-bowl stack, continuing to align and lower in small steps.
The third bowl is near the stack, with little clearance between its base and the stack edge. I will lift slightly first, then align laterally by centimeters to avoid a side collision.

The grasp is currently stable, and the third bowl is gradually approaching the center of the stack. The two lower bowls remain nested. The next priority is to get the third bowl's base into the opening and supported.
The tool returned `done=true`: the operator authorization lease cannot cover the next complete action, so that action was not executed. I will immediately call finish_episode and send no further motion commands. The third bowl is still held in the air and requires the on-site operator to take over; ending the episode alone does not guarantee a physical stop or continued holding torque.
